title: Grid Data Sentinel: anomaly detection and repair for load telemetry with recursive TEDA, sparse autoencoders and calendar-aware profiles
description: Python package for detecting and repairing anomalous readings in electricity load series: a streaming recursive TEDA detector (typicality and eccentricity data analytics), a sparse window autoencoder, three reference detectors, labelled anomaly injection, an audited repair step, and a benchmark on public EIA-930 hourly demand. Part of the Cardinal Grid open initiative: cardinalgrid.com/sentinel.
